intro.text: stepping outside you felt immersed in something
from somewhere in the woods came a small sound
you wander into the woods. the sun is rising. there is no path
i want to hold something so tightly it hurts
you arrive at a hole that wasn’t there before
you have a feeling there is something in the hole
you have a half-eaten granola bar
… A L I G N M E N T …
on the way back you feel an ache
you walk but you might not be walking
you feel cool wind on skin that isn’t yours
it is now a day like any other
the unopened letters, the bruised wallpaper
a neutral smell you can't describe
you are experiencing these things like for the first time
you sit down with your coat still on
